facts.fact: The World Bank blog says the Merankabandi (Cash for Jobs) programme's CORE-MIS connects with multiple payment service providers, easing payment processing and reconciliation, and that field data collected with KoboToolbox flows directly into it; it was used to deliver emergency cash transfers to over 30,000 beneficiaries.

systems.platform: CORE-MIS (openIMIS), open source, World Bank Social Protection Global Solutions Group
systems.owner: Merankabandi (Cash for Jobs Project), hosted by the government at SETIC
